title: Gradual FP8 activation & sanity harness for E4M3/E5M2 on Hopper
creator: Jamie Chen
description:
Goal: Safely enable FP8 quantization profiles (E4M3 and E5M2 variants) on Hopper inference nodes with a staged activation path, strong telemetry gating, and a small automated sanity harness that catches accuracy regressions early. This ticket defines the activation plan, the lightweight runtime checks, and the stability fixes required before broad rollout.

Background: We've collected preliminary calibration outputs for FP8 across multiple models and shards but observed intermittent activation failures, per-layer sensitivity spikes, and occasional drift post-deploy. These manifest as token-level hallucinations on a small subset of prompts and subtle metric regressions in long-form tasks. The activation approach must be conservative: incremental activation, golden-seed comparisons, hysteresis-based reversion, and telemetry-driven canaries.

Scope: 1) Implement a "sanity harness" that runs a fast golden-seed inference suite inside the runtime during a canary window; 2) Add lightweight per-layer threshold checks and a stability score before profile activation; 3) Introduce temporal hysteresis and checkpointed state so activations can auto-revert if drift is detected; 4) Wire telemetry gating and an ops alerting page for failed activations; 5) Document rollout runbook for SRE and on-call teams.
acceptance_criteria: Sanity harness executes in <= 120ms additional latency per canary request and returns a stability score
Per-layer sensitivity thresholds computed from calibration data are persisted and consulted at activation time
Automated golden-seed comparison detects regressions >= 0.5% absolute ROUGE-L or token-level divergence > threshold and blocks activation
Hysteresis window implemented: profile must pass 3 consecutive canary checks over 15 minutes before full activation
Rollback triggers cause automatic reversion to INT8/FP16 within 30s and emit a structured incident event
Telemetry dashboard shows pass/fail rate, stability score histogram, per-layer outlier counts, and latency delta
notes: Initial calibration runs indicate E4M3 tends to be more conservative but exhibits layer 12 weight sensitivity on Model-A; E5M2 offers slightly better density but higher variance on long sequences.
Design review (2025-02-18): PM asked for an explicit golden-seed list; research proposed a 40-seed shortlist that covers edge-case tokens and long-context prompts.
Eng review (2025-02-22): Agreement to keep the harness modular so it can be dark-launched in Dedicated nodes first.
Risk: miscalibrated per-layer thresholds may block safe activations for benign workloads; will provide a fallback tuning pass in CI to suggest thresholds per model family.
telemetry_checks: stability_score <-> baseline correlation check (compute z-score vs last 24h)
per-layer outlier counter > 0 for more than 5% of requests in 1h window
token-delta regression alert if average token-confidence drops > 0.75 stddev
rollback_plan: On canary failure or SLO breach, runtime triggers immediate rollback: mark node as 'fp8-failed', restore last-good quant profile (INT8/FP16), 1) publish incident event to ops channel, 2) run a fuller golden-seed sweep to collect artifacts for root-cause, 3) pin nodes to conservative profile until follow-up patch. Manual rollback runbook included in playbook doc.
qa_test_plan: 1) Unit tests for per-layer threshold logic and hysteresis state machine; 2) Integration smoke that runs the 40 golden seeds against a sandboxed canary cluster; 3) Load test with 1k qps to ensure harnessing overhead stays within budget; 4) Regression suite comparing token-level diffs vs golden baseline; 5) Canary health checks exercised in staging for 48 hours before production ramp.
